item.title: Setting up Layer5 Account
item.description:
This guide will walk you through setting up your Layer5 account, and through the profile, password, linked sign-in, account deletion, and subscription settings that belong to that account.

Configuring your Layer5 account 🔗

The first steps in starting with Layer5 are to create an account, verify your email, sign in, and view your profile. You do not name an organization or a workspace yourself. Layer5 Cloud creates an organization, a team, and a workspace the first time the new account signs in successfully. Submitting the sign-up form alone does not create them. An email sign-up signs you in immediately, so that first sign-in happens as part of registration. The Check your email page and the Import from GitHub first-run page described below arrived in Layer5 Cloud v1.0.278.

item.title: Creating a Design from Meshery Catalog Templates
item.description:
The catalog is a public collection of designs for cloud native infrastructure. Browsing it needs no account. Cloning does. This page walks through finding a design, trying it without changing anything, and cloning it into your workspace as a private copy.

Cloning a design from a template in the Meshery Catalog 🔗

Cloning needs the Clone Design permission. These built-in roles hold it, and they also hold View Designs: the User role, Team Admin, Workspace Admin, Organization Admin, and Provider Admin. If your role lacks Clone Design, the clone action is shown disabled.

item.title: Integrating GitHub with Meshery
item.description:
Introduction 🔗

The GitHub integration connects your GitHub account to Layer5 Cloud through the Layer5 GitHub App. Once connected, you can browse the repositories you granted, pick Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, Docker Compose files, Kustomize, and Meshery designs, and import each file as a design. The same connection can also install a pull-request snapshot workflow.

Use it when your infrastructure already lives in Git. For a one-off file, import it directly instead.
